nodes.title: Query points
nodes.description: Universal search: nearest neighbours of a vector or point, recommend, hybrid (prefetch + fusion), order by payload; returns scored points

query.description: What to search for: {"nearest": [0.1, ...]} (vector), {"nearest": <point id>}, {"recommend": {"positive": [ids]}}, {"fusion": "rrf"} (with prefetch), {"order_by": "price"}, {"sample": "random"}

using.description: Named vector to search (collections with named vectors)

prefetch.description: Sub-queries for hybrid search / re-scoring, e.g. dense and sparse, fused by query {"fusion": "rrf"}

with_payload.description: Return the payload of each point

with_vector.description: Return the vectors of each point

shard_key.description: Shard key, for collections with custom sharding

consistency.description: Read consistency across replicas (default: one replica)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

nodes.description: Insert or overwrite points by id: [{"id": 1 | "uuid", "vector": [...] | {"name": [...]}, "payload": {...}}] (as an agent tool only when QDRANT_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1)

update_filter.description: Only overwrite existing points matching this filter (new points are always inserted)

shard_key.description: Shard key, for collections with custom sharding

wait.description: Wait until the change is applied (false: return once queued)

filter.description: Change every point matching this filter instead of ids

key.description: Set the payload under this nested key, e.g. meta.review
